edit.description: widen CJS_CONTEXT_NAMESPACE_QUERY to both spellings of the query
the literal-spelling case beside the percent-encoded one

summary: CjsContextLoadError misses tsx's literal `?namespace=` query, so a win32 consumer gets the raw loader stack instead of the named fix

per.section: A broken chain fails loudly, at two layers

acceptance: an ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND carrying the query in either spelling refuses with the named fix; a bare one still passes through unchanged
tests: tsx 4.23 signature — ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with a literal ?namespace= query throws CjsContextLoadError naming the fix
notes: Downstream report, 0.17.0 on win32. The class doc already says the path may arrive percent-encoded — reads as 'sometimes' — so the regex was narrower than its own narration. The one pinning case plants the encoded spelling alone.

edit.description: render a findings list to one assertable line
every live-tree verdict asserts the rendered form, not an array

summary: Live-tree citation verdicts assert an array empty, so the failure's first line elides which site dangled and a retry must re-run the suite to learn it
acceptance: each live-tree verdict asserts a rendered string, so a gate-revert's reported detail names every dangling site
tests: the citation scan's findings render to one line naming every dangling site
notes: Measured: three entries in one wave reverted with detail `expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []` and no site. TestFailure.message is the first line by contract (harness/runner.ts); sibling assertions in the same tests already use the string form.

the page-to-schema direction beside the schema-to-page one

summary: docs/LAYERS.md names `jobs` as a declaration field the job cut retired; the field pin reads schema-to-page only, so the stale claim stays green
acceptance: LAYERS names no field DeclarationSchema lacks, and the pin reds on one that reappears
tests: docs/LAYERS.md names no declaration field DeclarationSchema does not declare
notes: Downstream report, 0.17.0. `harness/declaration.ts` carries no `jobs`: the cut made an effort a checkout (spec/jobs.md, The checkout is the unit of isolation). The consumer's per-checkout fence need is parked separately, not answered here.
